activity.notes: Yeltsin's presidency began with his inauguration on 10 July 1991. ATLAS separates the final Russian SFSR phase from the Russian Federation phase at the formal state-name change of 25 December 1991.

sources.title: Boris Yeltsin — President of Russia
sources.citation_text: The official Kremlin biography records Yeltsin's 1991 election as the first president of Russia and his resignation on 31 December 1999.

sources.title: Presidency of Boris Yeltsin
sources.citation_text: The detailed presidency chronology gives the first inauguration on 10 July 1991 and the end of the presidency on 31 December 1999.
